column1: # Every compiled default/no-op/unsupported body candidate must match exactly one
# first-priority review rule. These rules classify implementation evidence; they
# do not add product exclusions or turn unfinished behavior into an exclusion.

column8: The pinned upstream declaration and generated source were reviewed: nullable misses, false capability flags, immutable-operation failures, visitor hooks, lifecycle no-ops, and identity defaults are intentional semantics rather than stubs.
